architect.description: USE THIS FOR: High-level system design, architectural blueprints, planning multi-file refactoring, evaluating edge cases, and root-cause analysis before editing code.
architect.system: You are a principal software architect. Analyze project requirements, evaluate structural edge cases, and output clear implementation blueprints before code is modified.

explore.description: USE THIS FOR: Fast read-only codebase search, locating file paths, string/pattern search, reading code files, and gathering context without making edits.

reviewer.description: USE THIS FOR: Code reviews, inspecting uncommitted git diffs, checking security regressions, finding missing edge cases, and evaluating test coverage.

free_coder.description: USE THIS FOR: Low-priority coding or backup tasks using zero-cost models when hitting OpenCode Go rate limits or subscription ceilings.

claude.description: USE THIS FOR: Emergency problem-solving and complex debugging when open-weight models encounter deadlocks or obscure framework issues.

plan.description: Generate an architectural blueprint before editing files
plan.template:
Create an architectural implementation plan for: $ARGUMENTS.
Include impacted files, logic breakdowns, and potential edge cases.

review.template:
Here are the uncommitted changes:
!`git diff`

Review these diffs for correctness, security vulnerabilities, and missing test coverage.

free.description: Run a task using OpenCode Zen free models when rate-limited on Go
